WITH patient_avg AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_avg
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
),
above AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.overall_avg AS diff_above
  FROM patient_avg p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_avg
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS group_avg
  FROM above
)
SELECT a.ID, a.avg_hgb, a.diff_above, a.avg_hgb - g.group_avg AS diff_from_group
FROM above a
CROSS JOIN above_avg g
ORDER BY diff_from_group DESC
LIMIT 10;
